note: What a native frame may differ from the web picture of the same frame and still pass (#569). Channel units, 0..255.
grid: the picture is judged in columns x rows regions; a region's delta is the largest difference between the two pictures' mean channel values there.
blank: a native frame with less spread or fewer colours than this, or more of it the clear colour, drew nothing.
noise: two read-backs of one frame on one device. Measured 0 on both backends: a frozen frame draws identically, so anything above a hair is not noise.

web: measured in hosted run 38972400131 (Android API 35 GLES on SwiftShader, iPhone 16 / iOS 18.5 Metal simulator). Each scene allows about two and a half times the worst of the two backends, and at least 0.5 mean and 1.5 in a region; a scene with no entry of its own gets the default.
shift: the alignment found was 0 pixels on every scene on both backends.
